title: Daydreaming: Stealing Hidden Agent Skills through Black-Box Task Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.26733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills bundle instructions, reference data, and executable helpers that let a general agent perform specialized tasks. Hosted providers can keep these files secret while selling access to task results, making the skill itself a valuable target. Existing disclosure defenses can block requests that ask for the skill or reproduce its text, but they cannot block customers from submitting the ordinary tasks the service is built to complete. We present Daydreaming, an execution-only attack that steals a multi-file skill through black-box task interactions. The victim is never asked to reveal the skill or grade a reconstruction. Instead, Daydreaming adaptively creates crafted tasks whose results distinguish possible hidden behaviors. It tests individual behaviors, uses attacker-controlled shadow agents to choose a design, and completes each file using stored victim results and local execution checks. translated_title: 白日梦：通过黑盒任务交互窃取隐藏的智能体技能
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26733v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：智能体技能将指令、参考数据和可执行助手捆绑在一起，使通用智能体能够执行专门任务。托管提供商可以对这些文件保密，同时出售任务结果的访问权限，从而使技能本身成为有价值的目标。现有的披露防御措施可以阻止请求技能或复现其文本的查询，但无法阻止客户提交服务设计用于完成的普通任务。我们提出了“白日梦”（Daydreaming），一种仅通过执行的黑盒攻击，通过黑盒任务交互窃取多文件技能。受害者从未被要求揭示技能或对重建进行评分。相反，“白日梦”自适应地创建精心设计的任务，其结果能区分可能的隐藏行为。它测试单个行为，使用攻击者控制的影子智能体选择设计，并通过存储的受害者结果和本地执行检查完成每个文件。我们形式化了三个嵌套威胁层级。
tldr: 本文提出“白日梦”攻击，通过黑盒任务交互在无需受害者泄露或评分的情况下，利用自适应任务设计窃取多文件智能体技能，并形式化了三个威胁层级。
en_tdlr: This paper presents "Daydreaming," an execution-only attack that steals multi-file agent skills via black-box task interactions, using adaptive task design without victim disclosure, and formalizes three nested threat levels.
